scope: Add the single consent row immediately below Log In; keep existing campus photo, copy, Cimoa brand, source buttons and lower legal paragraph

geometry_css_px.consent_links: theme text.title; normal weight; no underline in the new row
geometry_css_px.font_estimation: PNG has no editable font metadata. Existing platform font adjusted to measured new-label ink bounds x=57..278.5, y=751..762.5 CSS px at 393x852; text and size are not guessed from the old HTML.
geometry_css_px.consent_letter_spacing: -0.005em; tuned to measured PNG label ink extent with the existing platform font

copy.consent: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
copy.validation: Please agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.

state.default: unchecked; never infer consent from having read an agreement
state.checked: both auth entry buttons navigate once
state.unchecked: both auth entry buttons retain route and show validation on attempted activation; aria-disabled=true; source button appearance retained
state.legal: all four Terms/Privacy links open independent policy pages without checking or toggling the box
state.return: cached Welcome instance retains the choice when returning from agreements, Age or Login
state.refresh: new Welcome instance resets to unchecked
state.persistence: none: transient entry confirmation, not a new legal acceptance record; final registration agreements remain separately validated by Store
state.loading: none for transient checkbox and navigation
state.errors: navigation/media failures keep normal retry paths

approved_deltas: New PNG overrides the prior HTML only for the explicitly requested consent/footer increment.
Continue using approved Cimoa brand, not CIRCA. Do not draw source status bar, EUL debug chip, home indicator or caption.
Screenshot depicts checked state; fresh entry defaults unchecked to require an explicit choice.
Unchecked uses an empty outlined box and blocks both auth entries; only attempted invalid activation displays English validation.
Reuse the single middle scroll region on smaller/safe-area devices; do not shrink fonts or add another scroll container.
